title: 軌道運輸無障礙月台
summary: 本課聚焦月台車輛幾何介面與連續無障礙路徑。從月台與車體界限建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把無障礙完整旅程與協助登乘時間連成可驗證的介面，最後以使用性測試推論整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies platform–vehicle geometry and continuous accessible journeys. Start with platform and vehicle bounds to define physical or information boundaries, connect complete accessible journey time with assisted boarding time as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through inference from usability trials. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究月台與車體界限。原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。敏感度只改 body=10 至 11 mm，輸出變為 22 mm；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究重複量測與共同偏差：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate platform and vehicle bounds. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. For sensitivity, change only body=10 to 11 mm; the output becomes 22 mm. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate repeated observations and shared bias: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 月台與車體界限與重複量測與共同偏差
stages.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds & Repeated observations and shared bias
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「月台與車體界限」與「重複量測與共同偏差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Platform and vehicle bounds" and "Repeated observations and shared bias": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「月台與車體界限」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform and vehicle bounds” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。保守界限可直接相加，而隨機誤差合成必須有分布與相關性證據；只在空車靜止狀態量一個間隙，無法代表載重與動態情境。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台與車體界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error. Conservative bounds can be summed, while stochastic combination requires evidence for distributions and correlation. One stationary empty-vehicle measurement cannot represent loaded and dynamic conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Platform and vehicle bounds” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台與車體界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Platform and vehicle bounds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 月台與車體界限
knowledge.text: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「月台與車體界限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Platform and vehicle bounds" is correct?
options: 三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將軌道、車體懸吊與測量誤差分開列帳，檢查空車靜態資料對載重狀態是否仍適用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Account separately for track, body suspension and survey uncertainty, checking whether empty stationary measurements remain applicable under load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「月台與車體界限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform and vehicle bounds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「月台與車體界限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Platform and vehicle bounds", which statement holds?
options: 平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。

Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「月台與車體界限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Platform and vehicle bounds” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。以「月台與車體界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources. For platform and vehicle bounds, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把車體位移界 body 從 10 改成 11 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 21 變為 22 mm。先說明「月台與車體界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only body displacement bound body from 10 to 11 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 21 to 22 mm. Explain the causal direction for platform and vehicle bounds, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把車體位移界 body 從 10 改成 11 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 21 變為 22 mm。先說明「月台與車體界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

quiz.question: 要驗證「月台與車體界限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Platform and vehicle bounds"?
options: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。

Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 月台與車體界限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Platform and vehicle bounds: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「月台與車體界限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Platform and vehicle bounds” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。回到「月台與車體界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. Trace the input chain for platform and vehicle bounds. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance.

steps.title: 無障礙完整旅程：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「無障礙完整旅程」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Complete accessible journey time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元從站外入口追蹤至車廂的連續路徑，將電梯等待、開門與協助時間納入相同系統邊界。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無障礙完整旅程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trace a continuous journey from the external entrance to the carriage, including lift waits, doors and assistance within one system boundary. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. knowledge.title: 無障礙完整旅程
knowledge.text: 本單元從站外入口追蹤至車廂的連續路徑，將電梯等待、開門與協助時間納入相同系統邊界。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。
knowledge.textEn: Trace a continuous journey from the external entrance to the carriage, including lift waits, doors and assistance within one system boundary. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無障礙完整旅程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Complete accessible journey time" is correct?
options: 平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
本單元從站外入口追蹤至車廂的連續路徑，將電梯等待、開門與協助時間納入相同系統邊界。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Trace a continuous journey from the external entrance to the carriage, including lift waits, doors and assistance within one system boundary.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
quiz.explanation: 本單元從站外入口追蹤至車廂的連續路徑，將電梯等待、開門與協助時間納入相同系統邊界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 無障礙完整旅程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Complete accessible journey time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「無障礙完整旅程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Complete accessible journey time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 無障礙完整旅程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Complete accessible journey time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「無障礙完整旅程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Complete accessible journey time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。以「無障礙完整旅程」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. For complete accessible journey time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Explain the causal direction for complete accessible journey time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「無障礙完整旅程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 無障礙完整旅程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Complete accessible journey time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「無障礙完整旅程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Complete accessible journey time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。回到「無障礙完整旅程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for complete accessible journey time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 輔具通行有效空間：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「輔具通行有效空間」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Clear space for mobility aids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把門扇、立柱與轉彎路徑視為幾何限制，明確區分通道流率算例與個人可通行性。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。單位寬流率是情境參數，受方向、坡度與群體能力影響；多條通道的容量只有在下游沒有共同瓶頸時才能直接相加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輔具通行有效空間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat door leaves, columns and turning paths as geometric constraints, distinguishing a passage-flow calculation from individual passability. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance. Specific flow is scenario dependent and varies with direction, slope and user capability. Parallel passage capacities may be added only when they do not share a downstream bottleneck. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. steps.instruction: 本單元把一般旅客交換與協助登乘分成可重疊或不可重疊工作，避免用平均停站時間壓縮必要協助。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「協助登乘時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instructionEn: Check whether participants represent meaningful capability differences; a finite set of successful trips does not establish access for every user.
